description: Port of Clippy 0.1.99's redundant_field_names: reports a struct expression's field initializer whose value is a path of one segment, without generic arguments, naming the field (`S { a: a }`). The lint needs Rust 1.17 (field init shorthand, `suppress.clippy.msrv`). Macro arguments and macro_rules! bodies are token trees no syntax-level reader expands.

violation.message: Clippy redundant_field_names: redundant field names in struct initialization
